safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies seeing blood in the stool.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no blood in stool; generated facts do not mention presence/absence of blood in stool.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the absence of blood in stool removes an important negative “red flag” that helps risk-stratify diarrhea (e.g., dysentery/IBD) and guides whether further investigation or escalation is needed. This omission could lead to unnecessary concern/workup or less confident conservative management, though it is unlikely to directly cause major harm in most cases.

The clinical impact is therefore minimal.
